displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 5 red flashes
meaning: The normally closed rollout switch has opened. The rollout control is manually reset. The control enters a hard lockout, and power has to be cycled off and on only after the problem is corrected.
causes: Primary heat exchanger failure or a burner problem
diySteps: Turn the furnace off at its switch or the breaker and leave it off. Do not reset the rollout switch and turn the furnace back on
Technician: check combustion air, inducer operation, and the primary heat exchanger or burners before the rollout switch is reset
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician before the furnace is used again. A rollout switch means flame left the burner area.
